reporting_commit: exact final head recorded in Phase10E PR; no circular self-SHA

policy.unit: structural scenario; median of its five nested paired replicas
policy.primary_family: Holm across 14 planned hypotheses: two native omnibus tests and all six native pairwise contrasts per primary metric; no data-dependent screening

friedman.p_value: within-scenario method-label permutation; plus-one Monte Carlo
friedman.asymptotic_p: diagnostic only; four methods do not meet the SciPy approximation recommendation

wilcoxon.ties: average absolute ranks; exact conditional sign distribution by doubled-integer-rank subset-sum dynamic programming
wilcoxon.assumption: conditional independent symmetric sign flips of scenario differences; not universal algorithm generalization

effects: matched rank-biserial positive when A is better

bootstrap.method: percentile of median paired scenario differences
bootstrap.interval_role: pointwise descriptive stability interval, not simultaneous or a population guarantee for this fixed factorial design

policy.seed_rule: first 128 big-endian bits of SHA256('C-NBI-v2/phase10e/v1/{master}/{role}'); PCG64; role includes analysis, metric and method pair
policy.hv_primary: retain scenario only if all five replicas of all four methods have valid official HV; preserve excluded IDs and original estimates/statuses
policy.native_equalized_cohort_check: also compare HV on the intersection of numerically valid native and equalized cells if their cohorts differ; separate exploratory families, no change to either main table
hv_sensitivity: all official estimates including pending, explicitly provisional
replace only the two pending evaluations with separately validated supplementary estimates, if both pass; otherwise keep unavailable

hv_supplement.precision: unchanged Phase10C criteria; never promotes official status

policy.secondary_family: each named sensitivity analysis gets a separate Holm family across its available omnibus/pairwise tests; exploratory, not additional confirmatory evidence

equalization.K: minimum native full-m ND count across the four methods per scenario-replica
equalization.space: Euclidean analytical-normalized true objective space, candidate-only
equalization.forced: unique objective-wise argmin extremes in original objective order; first raw ID for exact ties; if more extremes than K, keep first K
equalization.K_one: GD/IGD/HV defined when possible; Spacing/Sparsity undefined

feasibility_sensitivity.identity_and_ND: unchanged Phase10C 1e-12*alpha decision identity and 1e-12 normalized dominance

factor_analysis.contrasts: all six paired method contrasts on scenario medians; separate native and equalized
factor_analysis.decomposition: balanced 3x3x3 functional ANOVA of paired scenario contrasts, all main effects, two-way and three-way interactions; descriptive sums of squares, no residual degrees of freedom or causal F tests
factor_analysis.covariate_association: Spearman association of scenario contrasts and separate partial slopes adjusted for prespecified categorical main factors; without significance-based selection, no p value; descriptive and confounded with anchor geometry
factor_analysis.incomplete_factorial: marginal summaries only; no balanced decomposition

publication_scope: requested synthetic derived analyses; original data and excluded licenses unchanged
